findings.text: §53 charges the obligation to "the session named in the hold record", but a delivery hold records `by` as free text that defaults to the literal `coordinator`, and the cited record's value `nova-aa` is a holder label rather than the session id the obligation rows are keyed by; the declared write paths exclude the hold verb and `reckon/crew/resume.py`, so the plan does not decide whether the session id is newly recorded on the hold or the label is resolved to a session, and a hold taken with the default names no session for the obligation to follow
